name: Admin group member added (DCSync/ACL attack precursor)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4728, 4729, 4732, 4733, 4756, 4757) | where TargetAccount in ('Domain Admins', 'Administrators', 'Enterprise Admins', 'Schema Admins', 'Account Operators')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode IN (4728,4732,4756) TargetAccount IN ("Domain Admins","Administrators","Enterprise Admins")
tuning: Immediately suspicious unless driven by password manager/ITSM workflow.
